calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
nl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'mine' src, SUM(v) tot, COUNT(*) n FROM nl WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', SUM(net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mine_web', SUM(v), COUNT(*) FROM nl WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id=900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt_web', SUM(net_sales), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id=900

SELECT 'cur_dupe_skus' k, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) v FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupe_names', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sku)>1)
UNION ALL
